	AnyImage.grid.BHosCheckUS aa (NOLOCK),
	[MedcareUS].[dbo].[预约登记] bb (NOLOCK),
	AnyImage.v5.AUser cc 
WHERE
	Printed = 'T' 
	--AND aa.CrtDate>GETDATE()-1
	AND HISID1 > '' 
	AND bb.HISID IS NOT NULL 
	AND aa.BookID= bb.编号

CREATE VIEW [db_datareader].[CDR_CHECK_REPORT] AS
SELECT TOP 2000
	gb.PatientID1 +'|'+gb.AccessNo AS ROW_ID,
	gb.PatientID1 AS OUT_PATIENT_ID,-- 门诊患者标识
	gb.PatientID1 AS IN_PATIENT_ID,-- 门诊患者标识
	gb.InPatNo AS INP_NO,-- 住院号
	'' AS HEALTH_CAED_NO,-- 健康卡号
	'' AS CASE_NO,-- 病案号
	gb.PsNo AS PLS_NO,-- 病理号
	gb.PatientID1 AS OUT_NO,-- 门诊号
	gb.VisitID AS VISIT_ID,-- 就诊流水号
	CASE
		gb.PatSource 
		WHEN '门诊' THEN
		'1' 
		WHEN '住院' THEN
		'2' ELSE '' 
	END AS VISIT_TYPE_CODE,-- 就诊类型编码(1：门诊；2：住院)
	gb.PatSource AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME, -- 就诊类型名称(1：门诊；2：住院)
	gb.Name1 AS PERSON_NAME, -- 患者姓名
	CASE
		gb.Sex1 
		WHEN '男' THEN
		'1' 
		WHEN '女' THEN
		'2' ELSE '' 
	END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别编码
	gb.Sex1 AS SEX_NAME, -- 患者性别名称
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), gb.Birthday1, 23) AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, -- 出生日期
	'岁' AS AGE_UNIT, -- 年龄单位
	gb.Age1 AS AGE_VALUE, -- 年龄值
	'' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE, -- 证件类型编码
	'' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME, -- 证件类型名称

	'' AS ORDER_ITEM_CODE, -- 医嘱项编码
	'' AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, -- 医嘱项名称

	yydj.[收费项目] AS CHARGE_ITEM_NAME, -- 收费项名称
	'' AS APPLY_NO, -- 申请号
	'' AS MSR_NO, -- 放射号
	yydj.[检查类别代码] AS EXAM_CLASS_CODE, -- 检查类别编码
	yydj.[检查类别] AS EXAM_CLASS_NAME, -- 检查类别名称

	yydj.[检查项目代码] AS EXAM_ITEM_NAME, -- 检查项目编码
	yydj.[检查室] AS PLAN_EXAM_ROOM, -- 拟检查室
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_DOCTOR_CODE, -- 拟检查医师工号
	'' AS PLAN_EXAM_DOCTOR_NAME, -- 拟检查医师姓名
	yydj.[检查设备] AS PLAN_EXAM_DEVICE, -- 拟检查设备号
	'' AS APPOINT_DOCTOR_CODE, -- 预约医师工号

    SELECT
        LEFT(
            '49557032X' + '|' +
            ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(30), aa.AccessNo), '') + '|' +
            ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(30), bb.编号), '') + '|' +
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(200), aa.GCFW))), ''), '-'),
            100
        ) AS ID,   	--内码，按报告号+预约编号+部位区分
        '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE,   	--医院组织机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME,   	--医院名称

        CASE
            WHEN PatSource='门诊' THEN 1
            WHEN PatSource='住院' THEN 2
            WHEN PatSource='体检' THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END AS PATIENT_TYPE_CODE,   	--病人类型代码

        PatSource AS PATIENT_TYPE_NAME,   	--病人类型描述
        LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), aa.AccessNo), 20) AS REPORT_NUM,   	--单据号，保持报告单号一致

        '07' AS IMAGE_TYPE_CODE,   	--影像类别代码
        '镜检' AS IMAGE_TYPE_NAME,   	--影像类别名称

        '' AS OTHER_ID_TYPE,   	--其他身份证件标识
        '' AS OTHER_ID_NUM,   	--其他身份证件号码
        CASE
            WHEN LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(32), bb.身份证号), '')))) = 18
                THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), bb.身份证号))), 18)
            WHEN LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(32), bb.身份证), '')))) = 18
                THEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), bb.身份证))), 18)
            ELSE ''
        END AS ID_NUM,   	--身份证件号码
        Name1 AS NAME,   	--姓名

        CASE
            WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(Sex1)) = '男' THEN '1'
            WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(Sex1)) = '女' THEN '2'
            WHEN Sex1 IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(Sex1)) = '' THEN '0'
            ELSE '9'
        END AS SEX_CODE,   	--性别代码

        Sex1 AS SEX_NAME,   	--性别
        Phone1 AS TELEPHONE,   	--电话号码
        Age1 AS AGE,   	--年龄（岁）
        Month AS AGE_MONTH,   	--年龄（月）
        Day AS AGE_DAY,   	--年龄（天）
        Hour AS AGE_HOUR,   	--年龄（小时）
        PatientID1 AS VISITING_NUM,   	--就诊号

        '消化内科专业' AS DEP_NAME,   	--检查科室名称
        Ward AS AREA_NAME,   	--病区名称

        AccessNo AS EXAM_NUM,   	--检查号
        Eq AS EXAM_AIM,   	--检查目的
        HISID1 AS APPLY_NUM,   	--电子申请单编号

        '49557032X' AS APPLY_HOSP_CODE,   	--检查申请机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' AS APPLY_HOSP_NAME,   	--检查申请机构名称

        LEFT(ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(64), bb.申请科室代码), ''), 32) AS APPLY_DEPT_CODE,   	--检査申请科室代码
        LEFT(
            ISNULL(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), bb.申请科室))), ''),
                ISNULL(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(64), bb.送检科室))), ''),
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(64), aa.ApplyDept), '')
                )
            ),
            60

                )
            ),

        LEFT(
            ISNULL(
                NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), aa.ExamItemCode))), '"', ''), ''),
                ISNULL(
                    NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), bb.检查项目编码))), '"', ''), ''),

                )
            ),
            100
        ) AS HOS_EXAM_TYPE_CODE, --院内项目编码
        aa.HISID1 AS ORDER_ID, --检查医嘱ID
        '' AS REPORT_LINK, --报告文档链接
        '0' AS MTU_REC_MARK, --是否互认标识
        '' AS MTU_REC_LIMIT_MARK, --互认范围标识
        '' AS PROJECT_NAME, --国家平台项目名称
        '' AS PROJECT_CODE, --国家平台项目编码

        'US' AS SOURCE_TYPE_FOR_MAP
    FROM grid.BHosCheckUS aa WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN MedcareUS.dbo.预约登记 bb WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON aa.BookID = bb.编号
   JOIN
(
    SELECT
        cc2.ItemId,
        cc2.ItemName,
        cc2.ItemCode,
        cc2.ModifyDate
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            cc.ItemId,
            cc.ItemName,
            cc.ItemCode,
            cc.ModifyDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY cc.ItemId, cc.ItemName
                ORDER BY cc.ModifyDate DESC, cc.ItemCode
            ) AS rn
        FROM [10.10.9.146].[AM_MAQS].[dbo].[MEIDIKANG] cc WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE cc.ItemCode LIKE 'BC%'
    ) cc2
    WHERE cc2.rn = 1

    ON aa.HISID1 COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = cc.ItemId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT

    WHERE aa.Printed = 'T'
      AND aa.PrintTime >= '20210101'
      AND aa.PrintTime <  '20250101'

/* ===================== 第二层：清洗与内镜固定映射预处理 ===================== */
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[V_EMR_EXAM_IMAGE_REP_PREP]   --影像诊断报告清洗映射预处理层
AS
SELECT
    b.*,
    c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN,
    c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN,
    c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN,
    c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN,
    c.POS_CLEAN,
    m.ITEM_TEXT,
    m.POS_TEXT,
    x.UPPER_TEXT,
    x.IS_EXCLUDED_ES_ITEM,
    ip.INFER_POS,
    d.ES_DET_CODE,
    d.ES_DET_NAME
FROM dbo.V_EMR_EXAM_IMAGE_REP_BASE b
CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT
        NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.HOS_EXAM_TYPE_CODE) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)), '"', ''), '') AS HOS_CODE_CLEAN,
        NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.HOS_EXAM_TYPE_NAME) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)), '"', ''), '') AS HOS_NAME_CLEAN,
        NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.LOCAL_EXAM_CODE) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)), '"', ''), '') AS LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN,
        NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.LOCAL_EXAM_NAME) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)), '"', ''), '') AS LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN,
        NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.EXAM_POS_NAME) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)), '"', ''), '') AS POS_CLEAN
) c
CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT
        /*
          项目匹配文本：
          预约表收费项目/本地项目名称优先，其次院内项目名称、检查名称、操作名称。
          不再把 GCFW 部位当作项目名称使用。
        */
        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
            ISNULL(c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN, N'') + N' ' +
            ISNULL(c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN, N'') + N' ' +
            ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.EXAM_NAME) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'') + N' ' +
            ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.OPER_NAME) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'') + N' ' +
            ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(200), b.EXAM_AIM) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N''),
            N'＋', N'+'), N'（', N'('), N'）', N')'), N'　', N''), N' ', N''
        ) AS ITEM_TEXT,

        /*
          部位匹配文本：
          只使用检查部位 GCFW，不再拼 LOCAL_EXAM_NAME。
          这样可避免“收费项目=无痛胃肠镜”干扰部位判断。
        */
        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
            ISNULL(c.POS_CLEAN, N''),
            N'＋', N'+'), N'（', N'('), N'）', N')'), N'　', N''), N' ', N''
        ) AS POS_TEXT
) m
CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT
        UPPER_TEXT = ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(4000), b.REPORT_OBJECTIVE) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'') + N' ' +
                     ISNULL(CONVERT(nvarchar(4000), b.DIAGNOSIS_IDEA) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N''),
        IS_EXCLUDED_ES_ITEM = CASE
            WHEN b.SOURCE_TYPE_FOR_MAP = 'ES'
             AND (
                    c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN LIKE N'BC%'
                 OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN LIKE N'BC%'
                 OR c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000002', N'310902002', N'310901001', N'310904002', N'310902001', N'FGN000010')
                 OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000002', N'310902002', N'310901001', N'310904002', N'310902001', N'FGN000010')
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%彩超%'
                 OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%彩超%'
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%幽门螺旋%'
                 OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%幽门螺旋%'
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%胃酸监测%'
                 OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%胃酸监测%'
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%测压%'
                 OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%测压%'
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%胃肠电图%'
                 OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%胃肠电图%'
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%肺功能%'
                 OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%肺功能%'
                 )
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
) x
CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT
        INFER_POS = CASE
            WHEN x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%BBPS%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%进镜达回肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%回盲%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%升结肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%横结肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%降结肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%乙状结肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%直肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%大肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%结直肠%'
            THEN N'结肠'
            WHEN x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%食管%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%胃底%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%胃体%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%胃角%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%胃窦%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%十二指肠%'
              OR x.UPPER_TEXT LIKE N'%贲门%'
            THEN N'食管'
            ELSE NULL
        END
) ip
CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT
        ES_DET_CODE = CASE
            WHEN b.SOURCE_TYPE_FOR_MAP <> 'ES' OR x.IS_EXCLUDED_ES_ITEM = 1 THEN NULL

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000001', N'WJ000012')
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000001', N'WJ000012')
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%超声内镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%超声内镜%'
            THEN 'ES-GIU-00007'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN = N'GG310903006'
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN = N'GG310903006'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%乙状结肠镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%乙状结肠镜%'
            THEN 'ES-GIL-00003'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN = N'310903014-1'
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN = N'310903014-1'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%胶囊内镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%胶囊内镜%'
            THEN 'ES-OTH-00001'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN = N'WJ000015'
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN = N'WJ000015'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%双气囊小肠镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%双气囊小肠镜%'
            THEN 'ES-OTH-00002'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN = N'WJ000016-1'
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN = N'WJ000016-1'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%单气囊%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%单气囊%'
            THEN 'ES-OTH-00003'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'GG310903005-1', N'WJ000009', N'5310', N'5351', N'5116')
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'GG310903005-1', N'WJ000009', N'5310', N'5351', N'5116')
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%无痛肠镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%无痛肠镜%'
            THEN 'ES-GIL-00002'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000008', N'GG310903005', N'5126')
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000008', N'GG310903005', N'5126')
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%纤维结肠镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%纤维结肠镜%'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%普通肠镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%普通肠镜%'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN = N'肠镜检查'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN = N'肠镜检查'
            THEN 'ES-GIL-00006'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'GG310902005-3', N'GG310902005-5', N'5127', N'5309', N'5307', N'5311', N'5350')
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'GG310902005-3', N'GG310902005-5', N'5127', N'5309', N'5307', N'5311', N'5350')
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%无痛胃镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%无痛胃镜%'
            THEN 'ES-GIU-00002'

            WHEN c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000007', N'GG310902005', N'5125')
              OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000007', N'GG310902005', N'5125')
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%纤维胃十二指肠镜%'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%纤维胃十二指肠镜%'
              OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN = N'胃镜检查'
              OR c.HOS_NAME_CLEAN = N'胃镜检查'
            THEN 'ES-GIU-00001'

            WHEN (
                    c.LOCAL_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000006', N'WJ000011', N'5128', N'5304', N'5305')
                 OR c.HOS_CODE_CLEAN IN (N'WJ000006', N'WJ000011', N'5128', N'5304', N'5305')
                 OR c.LOCAL_NAME_CLEAN LIKE N'%无痛胃肠镜%'

            WHEN (

create view VS_Report_MDK
as 
select 
cast([BHosCheckES].[ID] as nvarchar(40)) as FillerOrderNo,--流水号(ServiceRequest.FillerOrderNo)
cast([BHosCheckES].[ID] as nvarchar(40)) as ReportID,--报告ID
cast('OBS1' as nvarchar(10)) as ClassID,--大类ID（例如：放射、超声）
cast('内镜' as nvarchar(20)) as ClassDescription,--大类描述
cast([ReCheckID] as nvarchar(40)) as RequestedProcedureID,--检查号
cast(case when len([PatientID1])<>0 then 'DW_'+[PatientID1] else [PatientID1] end as nvarchar(50)) as PatientID,--病人ID
cast([BHosCheckES].visitid as nvarchar(50)) as VisitID,--
cast([BHosCheckES].[InPatNo] as nvarchar(50)) as VisitNumber,--就诊ID
cast(case when printed='T' then '60' when [OPSDesc] is null then '20' when BeginRpt<>'T' then '40' else '50' end as nvarchar(20)) as ReportStatus,--报告状态
cast(case when printed='T' then '报告发布' when [OPSDesc] is null then '登记' when BeginRpt<>'T' then '检查中' else '完成报告' end as nvarchar(60)) as ReportStatusDescription,--状态说明
cast([CrtDate] as datetime) as RequestDateTime,--请求时间
cast('' as nvarchar(20)) as OrderingProviderNo,--请求医生
cast('' as nvarchar(40)) as OrderingProviderName,--
cast('' as nvarchar(40)) as OrderingDepartmentID,--请求科室
cast([BHosCheckES].[ApplyDept] as nvarchar(60)) as OrderingDepartmentName,--
cast([BHosCheckES].[PatSource] as nvarchar(40)) as OrderingFacilityID,--请求机构
cast([BHosCheckES].[PatSource] as nvarchar(60)) as OrderingFacilityName,--
cast([BHosCheckES].[PsDiagnose] as nvarchar(100)) as RelevantClinicalInfo,--临床诊断
cast('' as nvarchar(20)) as AssistantResultInterpreterNo,--初写人
cast([BHosCheckES].[ReportDr] as nvarchar(40)) as AssistantResultInterpreterName,--
cast([BHosCheckES].[ExamDate] as datetime) as ResultDateTime,--初写时间
cast('' as nvarchar(20)) as PrincipleResultInterpreterNo,--审核人
cast([BHosCheckES].CheckDr as nvarchar(40)) as PrincipleResultInterpreterName,--
cast('' as nvarchar(10)) as ReaderPieceDoctorNo,--读片医生
cast([BHosCheckES].[ReportDr] as nvarchar(40)) as ReaderPieceDoctorName,--
cast([BHosCheckES].[CheckTime] as datetime) as FinalResultDateTime,--审核时间
cast([BHosCheckES].[WkStation] as nvarchar(40)) as TechDeptCode,--检查科室
cast([BHosCheckES].[WkStation] as nvarchar(60)) as TechDeptName,--
cast([BHosCheckES].[PrintTime] as datetime) as PublishDate,--报告发布时间
cast('' as nvarchar(max)) as DiagnosticImagingTech,--横表，有些产商是纵标
cast([BHosCheckES].[OPSDesc] as nvarchar(max)) as ImagingFindings,--所见
cast([BHosCheckES].[PsDiagnose]+[OPSDiagnose] as nvarchar(max)) as ImagingConclusion,--所得
cast([BHosCheckES].HP as nvarchar(20)) as IsPositive,--阴阳性
cast([BHosCheckES].eqno as nvarchar(40)) as ReportDisplayID,--报告明细ID
cast('' as nvarchar(10)) as HospitalID,--
cast('[BHosCheckES]' as nvarchar(50)) as Feed,--源说明
cast('ID' as nvarchar(200)) as FeedKey,--源KEY
cast([BHosCheckES].[ID] as nvarchar(200)) as FeedValue,--源KEY值
cast(0 as smallint) as IsDeleted,--是否(物理)删除
cast([BHosCheckES].updDate as datetime) as LastUpdateDtTm--源最后更新时间
from  grid.[BHosCheckES]    
where id<>2

create view VS_RequestProcedure_MDK
as 
select 

cast([BHosCheckES].[ID] as nvarchar(60)) as FillerOrderNo,--检查流水号（ServiceRequest.FillerOrderNo）"

cast('ID' as nvarchar(200)) as FeedKey,--源KEY
cast([BHosCheckES].[ID] as nvarchar(200)) as FeedValue,--源KEY值
cast(0 as smallint) as IsDeleted,--是否(物理)删除
cast([BHosCheckES].updDate as datetime) as LastUpdateDtTm--源最后更新时间
from  grid.[BHosCheckES]    
where id<>2
